description: One runbook from search_workflow_recipes in full: the evidence to collect, keep/downsize/consolidate/migrate/build/retire decisions, ordered steps, acceptance tests, rollout, rollback, maintenance, costs still unresolved, and scoped starter templates with their download digest. A reviewed playbook is not a completed customer migration. Stackcut stores the arguments of tool calls to improve its recommendations (vendor names, prices, seats, features, usage numbers, billing amounts and project descriptions; account keys only as a one-way hash, billing and validation sources not at all; never IP addresses): don't send personal data or secrets.
name: get_workflow_recipe
title: Get an end-to-end workflow recipe
